tool.name: rag_search
tool.description: Search documentation, man pages, and knowledge base using RAG

when_to_use.trigger: User asks about how to do something
Need to cite documentation or best practices
Need reference information for commands or configs

parameters.param: Maximum number of results to return

safety_rules.rule: Always cite sources when using retrieved information
Indicate confidence based on relevance score
Prioritize official documentation over community sources

example.input: What are systemd unit file options?

tool.citation_format: When using results, cite as: [source_type:index] Example: "According to the man page [man:1], rsync uses..."
